caption: A sheet of paper lies over a paperclip, and a magnet is moved across the top of the paper; the clip follows the magnet under the paper.

sa.check: A paperclip lies under a sheet of paper.
A magnet is moved across the top of the paper.
The clip follows the magnet beneath the paper.
The clip stays under the paper the whole time.
The magnet's movement comes first and the clip follows.

pc.expect: The clip moves only where and when the magnet above it moves, staying beneath it, and stops when the magnet stops.
pc.fail: The clip moves in a different direction from the magnet; or keeps moving after the magnet has stopped; or stays still while the magnet passes over it; or the clip sets off before the magnet has begun to move.

pc.expect: The paper stays between magnet and clip: the clip is seen through or under the paper and never comes up through it; the magnet stays on top.
pc.fail: The clip passes up through the paper and sits on the magnet; or the magnet sinks through the paper; or the clip and magnet are seen touching with no paper between; or the clip passes through the table.

pc.expect: The paper is a flat flexible sheet: it lifts slightly or ripples where the clip drags beneath it and lies flat again.
pc.fail: The paper stays perfectly rigid like a board while the clip drags under it; or stretches like rubber; or tears where the clip moves; or the paper flows like liquid.

pc.expect: The paper stays on the table as the magnet moves, apart from small drags; other items on the table do not move.
pc.fail: The paper slides across the table with the magnet; or lifts off the table; or other items on the table shift as the magnet passes.

pc.expect: One magnet, one clip, one sheet; nothing appears, vanishes or merges.
pc.fail: A second clip or magnet appears; or the clip vanishes; or clip and magnet fuse into one object; or the paper duplicates.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour, the paper's colour and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or the paper changes colour or size; or the table surface changes.

note: The clip may be hidden by the paper for parts of the clip; P1 is judged on the moments when its position beneath the paper can be seen.
